description: Use when building falling leaves that read as leaves (not confetti): each leaf tumbling on its own axis with sideways slip driven by that tumble. Covers 2D canvas and instanced 3D, recycling, density maths, depth layering, tone-mapped colour, reduced motion, and visibility pausing—for maple, sakura, blossom, ash, or snowfall shapes.
